title: ReliefWeb Publishes Comprehensive DRC Ebola Situation Report — 4 June 2026
detail: ReliefWeb published a comprehensive DRC Ebola outbreak situation report for June 4, 2026, covering outbreak context, population vulnerabilities, updated case counts spanning Ituri Province, and international response coordination. The report documents the ongoing Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak spanning multiple health zones in Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu provinces of DRC, as well as cross-border Uganda cases. International response coordination efforts — including WHO, UNICEF, MSF, and partner organizations — are detailed alongside current epidemiological trends. The situation report reflects the continued active phase of the 2026 outbreak with active case investigation and response operations across affected areas.
